description: Sunwise is an all-in-one platform designed for solar installers to manage and grow their business more efficiently. The app helps you organize projects, track leads, create proposals, and coordinate your team from a single, easy-to-use workspace. By centralizing daily operations, Sunwise saves time, reduces manual work, and gives installers better visibility into their sales pipeline and ongoing installations—so you can focus on delivering great solar projects to your customers.
